mapper.sql: run.tenant_id,run.session_id,run.root_input_id,run.run_id,action.action_id,action.kind,action.action_ordinal AS ordinal, (SELECT count(*) FROM agent_runtime_execution_actions m WHERE m.tenant_id=run.tenant_id AND m.run_id=run.run_id AND m.kind='MODEL' AND m.action_ordinal<=action.action_ordinal) AS model_ordinal, attempt.attempt_id,attempt.adopted,action.selected_attempt,invocation.invocation_id,invocation.provider, COALESCE(NULLIF(invocation.metadata->>'model',''),NULLIF(invocation.service,'')) AS model, COALESCE(NULLIF(invocation.metadata->>'call_point',''),NULLIF(invocation.metadata->>'callPoint',''),'model.chat') AS call_point, COALESCE(attempt.result_kind,'UNRESOLVED') AS status, invocation.started_at,invocation.ended_at,event.event_id AS trace_node_id, attempt.request_ref,request.schema_id AS request_schema,request.canonical_json AS request_json, attempt.result_ref,result.schema_id AS result_schema,result.canonical_json AS result_json, CASE WHEN usage.prompt_tokens IS NOT NULL OR usage.completion_tokens IS NOT NULL OR input.reported IS NOT NULL OR output.reported IS NOT NULL THEN 'PROVIDER_REPORTED' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS usage_source, COALESCE(usage.prompt_tokens,input.reported) AS prompt_tokens,COALESCE(usage.completion_tokens,output.reported) AS completion_tokens, usage.cached_input_tokens,usage.cache_write_input_tokens,usage.reasoning_output_tokens,usage.ingested_at

JOIN public.agent_runtime_execution_actions action ON action.tenant_id=run.tenant_id AND action.run_id=run.run_id AND action.kind='MODEL' JOIN public.agent_runtime_execution_attempts attempt ON attempt.tenant_id=action.tenant_id AND attempt.run_id=action.run_id AND attempt.action_id=action.action_id JOIN public.agent_runtime_execution_materials request ON request.tenant_id=attempt.tenant_id AND request.reference=attempt.request_ref LEFT JOIN public.agent_runtime_execution_materials result ON result.tenant_id=attempt.tenant_id AND result.reference=attempt.result_ref LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT invocation.provider,invocation.metadata,invocation.service,invocation.invocation_id,invocation.started_at,invocation.ended_at FROM public.nw_external_invocations invocation WHERE invocation.tenant_id::text=attempt.tenant_id AND invocation.attempt_id=attempt.attempt_id AND invocation.operation_type='model.chat' ORDER BY invocation.id LIMIT 1) invocation ON true LEFT JOIN public.agent_runtime_budget_attempt_amounts input ON input.tenant_id=attempt.tenant_id AND input.attempt_id=attempt.attempt_id AND input.dimension='INPUT_TOKENS' LEFT JOIN public.agent_runtime_budget_attempt_amounts output ON output.tenant_id=attempt.tenant_id AND output.attempt_id=attempt.attempt_id AND output.dimension='OUTPUT_TOKENS' LEFT JOIN public.observation_effective_model_usage usage ON usage.tenant_id::text=attempt.tenant_id AND usage.attempt_id=attempt.attempt_id AND usage.session_id=run.session_id AND usage.run_id=run.run_id AND usage.root_input_id=run.root_input_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT event.event_id FROM public.agent_runtime_execution_events event WHERE event.tenant_id=attempt.tenant_id AND event.run_id=attempt.run_id AND event.canonical_json::jsonb->>'actionId'=action.action_id AND (event.canonical_json::jsonb->>'attemptId'=attempt.attempt_id OR action.selected_attempt=attempt.attempt_id) ORDER BY event.event_sequence LIMIT 1) event ON true

SELECT FROM public.nw_chat_sessions session JOIN public.agent_runtime_execution_runs run ON run.tenant_id=session.tenant_id::text AND run.session_id=session.session_id
WHERE session.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND session.session_id=#{session} AND attempt.attempt_id=#{attempt} AND (#{root,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR run.root_input_id=#{root,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) LIMIT 2

WITH members AS ( SELECT b.action_id,CASE WHEN b.reused THEN b.first_attempt_id ELSE a.current_attempt END AS attempt_id,b.slot FROM public.agent_runtime_execution_batch_members b JOIN public.agent_runtime_execution_actions a ON a.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND a.run_id=b.run_id AND a.action_id=b.action_id WHERE b.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND b.run_id=#{run} AND b.source_attempt=#{attempt} UNION ALL SELECT a.action_id,a.current_attempt,row_number() OVER(ORDER BY a.action_ordinal)::integer AS slot FROM public.agent_runtime_execution_actions a WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND a.run_id=#{run} AND a.kind<>'MODEL' AND a.action_ordinal>#{ordinal} AND a.action_ordinal<COALESCE((SELECT min(m.action_ordinal) FROM public.agent_runtime_execution_actions m WHERE m.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND m.run_id=#{run} AND m.kind='MODEL' AND m.action_ordinal>#{ordinal}),9223372036854775807) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.agent_runtime_execution_batch_members b WHERE b.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND b.run_id=#{run} AND b.source_attempt=#{attempt}) ) SELECT a.tenant_id,a.run_id,a.action_id,a.kind,p.attempt_id,COALESCE(p.result_kind,'UNRESOLVED') AS status, p.request_ref,request.schema_id AS request_schema,request.canonical_json AS request_json, p.result_ref,result.schema_id AS result_schema,result.canonical_json AS result_json FROM members m JOIN public.agent_runtime_execution_actions a ON a.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND a.run_id=#{run} AND a.action_id=m.action_id JOIN public.agent_runtime_execution_attempts p ON p.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND p.run_id=a.run_id AND p.action_id=a.action_id AND p.attempt_id=m.attempt_id JOIN public.agent_runtime_execution_materials request ON request.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND request.reference=p.request_ref LEFT JOIN public.agent_runtime_execution_materials result ON result.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND result.reference=p.result_ref ORDER BY m.slot LIMIT 65
SELECT reference,schema_id,canonical_json FROM public.agent_runtime_execution_materials WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND reference IN #{reference}
